title: eesa
description: Extended Equipment Slot Adapter - A bridge between curios and trinkets
body:
# EESA

A bridge from Curios to Trinkets. **Very experimental and unfinished!**

## What?

EESA implements Curios's API using Trinkets, so you can use Curios-based NeoForge mods on Fabric with Trinkets.

## Why?

I didn't want to use Accessories. or NeoForge.

## Does it work?

Seems to, mostly. Somehow.

## Should I use this?

Probably not.

## Why not?

- No migration from Curios data to EESA
- Missing API implementations
- Bugs. Probably.

## Why is it named that?

Officially, "Extended Equipment Slot Adapter". Unofficially, the terrible logo design of the European Space Agency.
